interpretation.warmClean: The verification discovery runs after write-tree. 63ms at 10k, 137ms at 50k, 300ms at 100k. Roughly 2x the prior (no-verification) numbers because the loop now runs the discovery twice; the cost is still candidate-free when nothing changed.
interpretation.warm1Mod_warm1Del: Dominated by `git diff-files`'s O(N) stat walk on the shadow index, plus a second stat walk in the verification discovery. ~3.9s at 100k. The 100k numbers are slightly higher than the prior run (which ran discovery once) because the loop now runs it twice; the 10k/50k numbers are comparable.
interpretation.warm1New: `git ls-files --others` on the shadow walks the worktree to find untracked paths. At 100k this is ~17-21s. Note: the benchmark recreates the shadow for each scale, so the shadow's untracked cache (`core.untrackedCache=true`) starts cold. In production, the shadow persists across captures and the untracked cache warms, so the steady-state cost of `--others` is much lower. The prior benchmark (with `--others` on the source) benefited from the source's warm untracked cache during seedRepo; switching to the shadow removed that incidental benefit in the benchmark but is required for the persistent-incremental correctness model.
interpretation.followUp: Per the reviewer's instruction, no fsmonitor/split-index optimization in this pass. The cold-shadow-untracked-cache cost is the next investigation target.
